business_scope.primary_industry_name: Publishing of Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Games

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa - International Company (IC) Regime regulated by the Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English-derived common law tradition overlaid with indigenous customary law; unitary national legislation enacted in English)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Samoa-Australia Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA), in force 2010
Samoa-New Zealand Tax Information Exchange Agreement (TIEA), in force 2010
Samoa-Nordic States (Norway, Denmark, Finland, Sweden) Tax Information Exchange Agreements (TIEAs), in force 2010-2011
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER-Plus) Trade in Services commitment, in force 2020

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2015 and the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2018 (mandatory beneficial ownership register provisions); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2018 (Samoa), Part 3 (customer due diligence), Part 4 (suspicious transaction reporting), and PEP provisions; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Regulations 2019; SIFA AML/CFT Compliance Directives; Central Bank of Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit guidance; International Companies (Fees) Regulations 2015.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport biographical page of each shareholder, director, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of each respective country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by a licensed public notary, followed by consular legalization at a Samoan diplomatic mission because Samoa is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; alternatively, cross-certification by the SIFA-licensed registered agent is accepted only for Low_Risk_Standard non-face-to-face clients

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement issued within the preceding three months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed financial institution in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original or bank-certified statement; consular legalization required where the certifying institution is not an AML-regulated entity; otherwise licensed-agent cross-certification is accepted

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter or professional reference from an AML-regulated banker, lawyer, or chartered accountant confirming identity, financial standing, and source of funds
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Recognized financial institution or regulated professional in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original letterhead document signed by a licensed professional; consular legalization mandatory only where enhanced due diligence is triggered, such as foreign PEP involvement

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, and registry extract of any corporate UBO or entity shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-country company registry or equivalent corporate registrar
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing registry's home jurisdiction is a signatory to the Apostille Convention OR consular legalization at the nearest Samoan diplomatic mission; secondary verification by the SIFA-licensed registered agent is always performed

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the licensed Samoa registered agent to effect incorporation and file statutory returns
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each appointing natural-person UBO and corporate director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization plus consular legalization, or apostille where the signing jurisdiction is an Apostille state; executed in English or bilingually with a certified English translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation and ongoing screening of all UBOs, directors, registered-agent signatories, and beneficial shareholders against: (i) UN Security Council consolidated sanctions lists; (ii) OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List; (iii) UK HM Treasury Consolidated List; (iv) EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (v) Samoa domestic sanctions notices issued by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade and SIFA advisories; and (vi) Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) risk advisories. Foreign politically exposed persons (PEPs), their family members, and close associates require enhanced due diligence and senior-management approval under the AML/CFT Act 2018. The MMORPG business with exclusive Apple App Store and Google Play payout rails is rated Low_Risk_Standard; simplified due diligence is nevertheless unavailable for remote non-face-to-face UBOs, and transaction monitoring records must be retained for six years following termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SIFA International Business Registry - electronic name clearance, incorporation, and UBO filings are accepted exclusively through SIFA-licensed registered agents; no direct public self-service web portal exists. The domestic counterpart is the Samoa Companies Registry of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour in Apia.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered legal name must be rendered entirely in Latin script (A-Z, 0-9) and must incorporate one of the permitted suffixes: Limited, Ltd., Incorporated, Inc., Corporation, Corp., Public Limited Company, or Public Ltd. Ideographic or Chinese characters cannot form part of the registered legal name. Where the constituent documents are prepared in Chinese (全中文章程), a certified English translation must be filed with the Registrar, and the Chinese trading name may be recorded in the Memorandum and Articles of Association as an alternative business name for branding and intellectual-property purposes only; it confers no statutory name-protective effect in Samoa.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Deposit, Finance (where implying deposit-taking or licensed financial activity)
Fund, Mutual Fund, Capital (where implying collective investment scheme)
Government, Ministry, Authority, State, National, Central, Reserve, Treasury
Sovereign, Municipal, Council, Chamber of Commerce
University, College, Institute, Red Cross (implying professional or civic monopoly)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection: (1) the licensed registered agent files a Name Clearance Review Request (Form IC-NCR-R) with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, attaching a memorandum distinguishing the proposed name from the conflicting registered name; (2) the prescribed review fee of WST 100 (approximately USD 35) is paid; (3) the Registrar issues a written determination within 15 working days of receipt; (4) if the review is unsuccessful, the applicant may petition the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour for ministerial consent within 30 days; (5) ministerial denial remains subject to judicial review in the Supreme Court of Samoa. A successful name reservation is valid for 30 days and may be extended once for a further 30 days upon payment of the extension fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A conventional virtual office or co-working address does not satisfy the registered-office obligation: every International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Samoa at the premises of its licensed registered agent, open during normal business hours and capable of receiving legal process. Off-site cloud servers, remote game-development infrastructure, and a foreign operational headquarters for the MMORPG are unrestricted; the licensed agent's office serves as the statutory registered office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate for remote gaming operators: approximately 5% annualized probability that SIFA's AML/CFT inspection team conducts an unannounced on-site visit to the licensed registered agent's premises, with client-file sampling expected during such inspections. Direct physical inspection of the principal's overseas development premises is not legally available to Samoan regulators.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Public notary registry and Samoan consular mission
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: notarial acts, consular legalization fees, and certified translation per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting bilingual Memorandum and Articles of Association (English-Chinese) with gaming-IP and in-app-purchase tailored clauses

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for MMORPG holding and global digital publishing structures

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for certified electronic filing and expedited international documentation delivery

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (No. 5 of 1987), as amended by the International Companies (Amendment) Act 2018, sections 3, 6, 7, 9, 11, 12, 18 (Registration), 24 (Registered Office), 29 (Registered Agent), 34 (Directors)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) — International Company Registry, Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association (M&A) together with Form IC-01 (Incorporate) and Registered Agent Consent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; shares may be issued at par, premium, or no par value, and no escrow account is required for paid-up capital
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the company adopts its Memorandum and Articles of Association and the subscribers named therein be and are hereby allotted fully paid ordinary shares. RESOLVED that the registered office in Samoa be established at the office of the licensed registered agent. RESOLVED that [Name] be appointed as director, [Name] as secretary, and such officers as the board may determine. RESOLVED that the board is authorized to open bank accounts with financial institutions, seal documents, and appoint local representatives. RESOLVED that any director may execute all incorporation and administrative documents with the corporate seal. CERTIFIED this [date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA International Company Registry, Apia, Samoa (in-person or through a licensed registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation form through a licensed registered agent containing two permissible company names in order of preference. Names must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing Samoa entity and must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd.' or 'SRL' as appropriate. Upon clearance, the name is reserved for 30 days.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If objection is raised, submit an amended name list or appeal to the Registrar under section 9 of the International Companies Act with written justifications.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent under the International Companies Act
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the M&A, including company name, registered office, share structure (authorized shares, no minimum paid-up capital), statement of limited liability, and the power to carry on any lawful business. Each subscriber signs the M&A before a notary public; the registered agent countersigns to verify adoption. Attach Articles prescribing director powers and quorum.
required_dossiers: subscriber identity and proof of address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Registrar requisitions are cured by preparing amendment pages, re-notarizing subscriber signatures, and resubmitting within 14 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the executed M&A, registered office consent, and annual fee declaration via SIFA lodgment portal or by courier. Pay the official state filing fee (approximately USD 100) by wire or credit. The Registry assigns the company number and enters the company on the International Companies Register.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, respond with a formal cover letter within 10 business days; the Registrar will pause or extend SLA upon written notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Initial Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA International Company Registry / Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues a Certificate of Incorporation. The registered agent prepares the company's share register, register of directors and officers, and the registered office register. Original certificates are retained by the agent and certified copies delivered to the beneficial owner.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any discrepancy in the certificate is rectified via Form IC-08 for correction; resubmission requires no fee for Registrar errors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Board Resolution and Governance Handover
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founding board adopts the First Board Resolution, ratifies share allotment to subscribers or approved nominees, designates the registered office, appoints directors, secretary, and any local representative. Minutes are signed and filed with the agent. Bank mandate and payment-rail accounts are then opened for App Store/Google Play payouts.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Reconvene the board within 48 hours to pass a corrective resolution; update registers to reflect the true appointment date.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — Samoa International Company is exempt from domestic industrial licensing; any physical Samoa business activity would fall under Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory operating licence required for offshore digital publishing; MMORPG publishing by an International Company does not require a sectoral permit

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) — Environment Impact Assessment Division, Apia, Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — no physical industrial activity, no manufacturing plant, and no emissions-generating operations in Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable: pure digital software publishing; zero local wastewater, VOC, or solid-waste discharge from the registered office

stage_2.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not mandatory for an offshore International Company with only a registered agent office; upon establishment of any physical premises in Samoa, the company must comply with the Fire and Emergency Services Act, building structural load certifications under the National Building Code, and Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013 workplace clearance requirements.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Revenue – Samoa, located at Level 2, FMFM II Building, Sogi, Apia; official tax portal: www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a Samoa International Company (IC) that is tax-exempt, no standard TIN or VAT registration is required automatically. However, the IC must apply to the Ministry of Revenue for a Tax Exemption Certificate (TEC) using Form TEC-1. This requires submission of the Certificate of Incorporation, the IC's registered office address, and a sworn declaration that no Samoa‐source revenue will be derived. Upon approval, the Ministry issues a Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) in a zero‐rated 'exempt' category, which must be quoted in any cross‐border contractual documentation. For ICs that later revoke the exemption, the standard corporate tax registration procedure applies via the Ministry of Revenue's online portal with submission of the Companies Registry extract and VAT registration application if applicable.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Under the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), an IC may irrevocably elect to be treated as a resident company under the Companies Act 2001. This election is filed with the Ministry of Revenue and the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) and prospectively subjects the company to Samoa corporate income tax (27% effective headline rate) and VAT, thereby terminating the exempt status. No 'check-the-box' or hybrid mismatch elections are available within Samoa's domestic tax law, but standard anti-hybrid rules under the International Companies (Tax) Amendment Act 2021 apply to prevent double non-taxation.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Goods and Services Tax Act 2008, administered by the Ministry of Revenue
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 (annual taxable turnover) for goods/services supplied in Samoa; a non-resident IC is generally outside the scope of VAT for offshore digital services, but if it derives any Samoa-sourced income (e.g., local app store sales) it would be required to register and charge VAT on those supplies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not operate a real-time fiscal clearance or continuous transaction control system. VAT invoices must be sequentially numbered and contain mandatory fields (seller name/TIN, buyer TIN, description, VAT rate). The Ministry of Revenue accepts electronic invoices (PDF/XMl) for audit purposes, but no government API or digital stamping is mandated. Approval of batch e-invoices is required for large exporters under the VAT Compliance Program.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and services are zero-rated under section 12 of the VAT Act, including digital services supplied to non-residents (MMORPG gameplay subscriptions, in-app purchases, virtual items). The IC must demonstrate that the recipient is a non-Samoan resident, that the service is performed and consumed outside Samoa, and that the IC retains conclusive evidence of the supply being made in the ordinary course of business. For payments processed by Apple App Store and Google Play, the 'agent/aggregator' model applies: the platform is the supplier to the end user, and the IC's settlement receipts from the platform are treated as consideration for zero-rated supply to the platform (a non-resident).
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Form SDF-7) endorsed by the Samoa Customs Service for physical exports (if any)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (for physical goods) or digital delivery log (server-side records, IP logs, platform settlement reports)
Inward Remittance Certificate or App Store/Google Pay settlement statement showing USD/WST transfer from the platform provider to the IC's bank account
Commercial contract between IC and Apple/Google, plus an annual zero-rated supply declaration (VAT Form ZRD-1)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry of Revenue may retrospectively assess VAT and impose penalties for improper zero-rating. Penalties include a late payment surcharge of 25% of the unpaid tax per annum, an additional negligence penalty of up to 200% of the evaded VAT, and criminal sanction for intentional misdeclaration (fine not exceeding WST 50,000 and/or imprisonment up to 3 years). In cases of fraudulent export schemes, the IC's tax-exempt certificate may be revoked retroactively, and all previously zero-rated supplies will be reclassified as taxable, with interest from the original supply date.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS) as administrator of the Exchange Control Act 2015, the Exchange Control Regulations 2016, and the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2021, with delegated enforcement authority vested in licensed authorized dealer banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is a managed-float currency with shallow offshore liquidity and no active offshore deliverable market. Resident enterprises are subject to comprehensive exchange control: current-account payments in foreign currency must be executed through an authorized dealer, individual remittances above the CBS declaration/approval threshold (typically WST 200,000 or equivalent) require regulatory declaration or prior approval, and all capital-account transactions require prior CBS consent. A licensed International Company under the International Companies Act 1987 is statutorily carved out of the exchange-control perimeter and is treated as non-resident: it may invoice, hold, borrow, and distribute in freely usable foreign currency (USD, EUR, HKD, SGD) without any CBS conversion mandate, and profit remittances to non-resident shareholders are unrestricted. The predominant practical hurdle is therefore not legal convertibility but correspondent-bank risk appetite toward Pacific offshore vehicles, mitigable by maintaining SIFA good-standing certificates, audited substantive gaming operations, and live Apple App Store / Google Play publishing contracts.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For ordinary resident exporters, the statutory surrender rules require all export proceeds to be repatriated to Samoa within 90 days of shipment or earnings, offered for conversion into WST through an authorized dealer, and held in a CBS-approved Foreign Currency Retention Account where applicable; set-off against offshore obligations without CBS approval is prohibited. For the WS_IC licensed International Company, no surrender rule and no mandatory conversion ratio apply: the entity may retain 100% of Apple App Store and Google Play USD payout proceeds in offshore or on-island USD accounts, entirely outside the Exchange Control Act 2015 surrender regime.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account (multi-currency USD/WST), optionally bifurcated into a USD Disbursement Account and a Restricted Reserve Account for covenant management

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-High for use as auxiliary collection and settlement rails, but onboarding volatility is elevated. Offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Payoneer) generally classify a Samoan International Company as a tax-haven-domiciled offshore vehicle and impose enlarged due diligence: Certificate of Incorporation, SIFA Certificate of Good Standing, registered-agent introduction letter, certified UBO passports, source-of-funds statements, and proof of substantive commercial activity comprising the Apple Developer Program Agreement and Google Play Console contract. Certain EMI terms of service contain territorial exclusions that may reject Pacific offshore islands; the robust mitigation is to maintain the primary USD operational account with ANZ Bank Samoa or a New Zealand/ANZ correspondent USD account and to use EMIs strictly as secondary conduits for app-store payout aggregation and foreign vendor disbursements.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory requirement mandates physical attendance of directors; however, licensed Samoan banks in practice require at least one authorized signatory to complete an identity attestation either in branch or via a CBS-compliant remote video verification process. ANZ Bank Samoa and BSP Samoa permit remote onboarding where the applicant is introduced by a licensed Samoan registered agent (corporate services provider), supported by notarized passports, certified constitutional documents, and a completed Bank Customer Due Diligence / AML/CFT entity questionnaire. The optimal structure is to appoint the licensed registered agent's resident principal as a co-signatory for administrative formalities while preserving full economic control with the non-resident beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity—nominee shareholding, bearer instruments, or unidentifiable ultimate ownership under Money Laundering Prevention Act 2021
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Register of Members and Register of Directors filed with the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA); government-issued photo identification and source-of-wealth statement for each natural-person UBO; registered-agent statutory declaration confirming ultimate beneficial ownership; complete chain-of-title documentation from the licensed corporate services provider.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore status flagged as a shell-company or tax-evasion conduit red flag
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Tax Exemption Certificate issued under the International Companies Act 1987; executed and currently subsisting Apple Developer Program License Agreement and Google Play Developer Distribution Agreement evidencing active MMORPG publication; monthly app-store sales and payout reports; audited financial statements or management accounts demonstrating genuine recurring revenue and operating expenditure; independent legal opinion confirming the lawful nature of the Samoan IC tax-exempt regime.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity cross-border digital revenue inconsistent with stated business model
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Historical payout statements from Apple App Store and Google Play aggregated by country, title, and settlement cycle; cloud-hosting and server infrastructure contracts corroborating live MMORPG operations; player transaction summaries demonstrating a genuine in-app purchase economy; documented AML/CTF, KYC, age-rating, and responsible-gaming policies applicable to the game platform.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Gaming activity misclassified as regulated gambling, betting, or e-money issuance requiring a Samoan licence
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Written legal opinion from Samoan counsel confirming that software publishing (ISIC 5820) and in-app purchase monetization do not constitute gambling, betting, or e-money issuance under Samoa law; game terms of service expressly prohibiting real-money gambling mechanics and unlicensed lotteries; confirmation from the Samoa International Finance Authority or Ministry of Commerce that no statutory licence is required for MMORPG publishing.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder loans and paid-in capital should be injected by SWIFT MT103 credit-transfer (or MT202 COVER for high-value transactions exceeding local linear limits) from the parent liquidity provider to the WS_IC USD operational account at ANZ Bank Samoa. Wire narrative must state 'International Company Act 1987 — shareholder loan / capital contribution — exchange-control-exempt'. Verification bundle: board resolution authorizing the issuance or borrowing; updated register of members; director source-of-funds statement; registered-agent conformity certificate. No CBS prior approval is required, but the receiving bank applies standard USD clearing due diligence; an initial economic buffer of USD 50,000–100,000 is recommended to satisfy bank risk appetite notwithstanding the absence of minimum statutory capital.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary clearing rail: SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers executed through ANZ Samoa or BSP Samoa electronic banking for vendor remuneration, licensor royalties, contractor fees, and intra-group settlements in USD or WST. Commercial Letters of Credit (UCP600) are viable only for co-publishing, master-licence, or content-acquisition contracts with documentary milestone conditions, issued through the bank's correspondent network (ANZ New York/Australia or BSP Sydney); LCs are not the default rail for digital service payments. App-store settlement: Apple App Store and Google Play remit aggregated USD payout batches (typically 30-day settlement cycles) via bank wire from Apple/Google treasury entities directly to the WS_IC USD account. Localized WST disbursements are executed as spot conversions through the authorized-dealer desk with fully recorded deal tickets and audit trail.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX Forward (outright forward) on USD/WST or USD/HKD with a licensed authorized dealer or offshore ISDA counterparty under an ISDA or long-form master agreement
Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF) on WST executed offshore (Singapore or Hong Kong) — preferred mechanism given the constrained onshore deliverable WST liquidity and settlement hurdles
Cross-Currency Swap (USD/WST or USD/other index) for tenor-matched rebalancing of USD app-store receipts against WST-denominated operating expenditures
Vanilla European-Style FX Options for contingent hedging of annual profit distributions and treasury liquidity peaks, subject to bank credit and suitability assessment

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) via the licensed Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable on the anniversary of incorporation; must be paid within the incorporation anniversary month; agent typically notifies 30 days in advance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 10% per month on the outstanding license fee; failure to pay for 6 consecutive months triggers administrative strike-off and dissolution under the International Companies Act 1987

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Registered Agent Compliance Declaration (UBO and Director Confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (maintained on file; no public government filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of each incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-submission is an offence under the International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) rules; agent may resign with 30 days' notice, triggering automatic appointment of a substitute agent or strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Maintenance and Updating of Statutory Registers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Office in Samoa (available for inspection by the Registrar upon request)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Registers to be updated within 14 days of any share transfer, director change, or charge creation; no annual filing required
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Default penalty of WST 50 per day under the International Companies Act 1987; continuing default may result in a court-imposed fine and strike-off

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit required for a standard International Company engaged in MMORPG publishing; mandatory independent audit applies only to licensees conducting banking, insurance, or fiduciary fund administration business; an audit may be triggered by a special resolution of members or a court order
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No mandatory filing of financial statements; books must be kept sufficient to reflect true financial position; financial statements, if prepared, must follow IFRS or a basis acceptable to the directors (no Local GAAP prescribed for International Companies)

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Samoa International Companies maintain a confidential Beneficial Ownership Register at the registered office; the registered agent must obtain an annual written confirmation from the directors identifying any change in beneficial ownership; share transfers must be recorded in the Register of Members and the UBO register updated within 14 days; no UBO filing is made to the public registry

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: 1,500 - 4,000 (voluntary audit only; not required for standard International Company)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Samoa International Company (IC) qualifies as a non-resident company under the International Companies Act 2017. Subject to meeting non-resident economic substance and management-and-control requirements, the IC may obtain a tax exemption certificate from the Ministry of Revenue (MOR), resulting in a 0% effective corporate income tax rate on qualifying offshore business income. No statutory tax holiday beyond the exemption certificate; the standard rate is 27% for resident companies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Income Tax Return Form (IRF-1) for International Companies, filed via the Ministry of Revenue's electronic filing portal (e-Samoa Tax Portal); alternatively paper filing with MOR.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The IC annual return must be filed within 6 months after the end of the fiscal year. The income tax return follows the same deadline: by 31 December for a 30 June year-end, or by 30 June for a 31 December year-end. A tax-exempt IC must still file an annual return to evidence continued exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 1: Company Identification Number / Entity ID
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IC registration number as issued by the Samoa International Companies Registry.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the IC number exactly as shown on the certificate; non-resident ICs must ensure the Samoan registered agent's name and address are included where required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Date of commencement and closing of the annual accounting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the financial statements' period; non-resident ICs with a global game publishing business should align to their audited consolidated accounts, typically the calendar year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3: Gross income from Samoan source
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: All income derived from sources within Samoa, including any locally-sourced IP royalties from distribution in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an offshore MMORPG publisher selling in-app purchases via Apple/Google globally, Samoan-source income is usually nil if no server or customer-facing activity is in Samoa. Enter '0' and attach a brief schedule if any Samoan source income exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4: Exempt income / Tax-exempt certificate reference
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income claimed as exempt under the International Companies tax exemption certificate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs claiming the exemption must insert the MOR certificate reference number (e.g., 'WS/MOR/IC-xxxx'). Without the certificate, the IC cannot claim exemption.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Combined assessable income after deducting exempt income from gross income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Where the exemption certificate applies, total assessable income = 0. If any non-exempt income (e.g., physical sales to Samoan residents through a local branch), compute at 27%.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Business expenses, depreciation, interest deductions, and tax loss carryforward of up to 5 years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident ICs should claim deductible expenses only against non-exempt income. For exempt ICs, no cost allocation required, but maintain transfer pricing documentation to support expense allocation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculated tax (27% of assessable income), net of any provisional payments or withholding credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For an exempt IC, tax payable = 0. If a payment method (Apple/Google) routed through Samoa is challenged, self-assess and include tax to avoid late-payment penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annex disclosing related-party transactions, the tested party, and the arm's length method adopted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident global publishers with related-party operating companies, IP holding, or sublicensing arrangements must complete TP-1 even when tax-exempt, to satisfy the Ministry of Revenue's transfer-pricing documentation requirements and avoid penalty presumption.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the IC annual return: WS$150 per day, up to WS$3,000. Failure to file income tax return when required attracts a maximum penalty of WS$5,000 and an additional 2% monthly late payment surcharge on unpaid tax.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Samoa's only comprehensive double tax agreement is with New Zealand. To apply for treaty relief: (1) obtain a New Zealand tax residency certificate (TRC); (2) submit a Samoan NR-1 withholding tax relief declaration to the paying Samoan company's agent or MOR; (3) attach the TRC and a beneficial ownership statement; (4) provide the electronic code if submitting e-filing; (5) MOR issues a reduced rate approval or the payer applies the treaty rate at source evidenced by the TRC. For all other jurisdictions, no treaty relief; statutory 0% dividend WHT applies as Samoa does not levy withholding tax on dividends.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory royalty WHT: 15% for royalties sourced in Samoa; statutory interest WHT: 15% for Samoan-source interest. Under the Samoa-New Zealand DTA, royalty rate reduced to 5% and interest rate reduced to 5% for financial institutions / 10% for other recipients.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WS$1,000,000 (approx USD $400,000) annual related-party turnover for the Local File and Master File; any cross-border related-party transaction above WS$100,000 also triggers simplified documentation. In practice, the Samoa MOR adopts OECD TP Guidelines; the IC must prepare contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation if the total value of related-party transactions exceeds WS$1,000,000 per annum.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa's Economic Substance Rules apply to International Companies under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2018 and the International Companies (Economic Substance) Rules 2021. An IC engaged in geographically mobile business (including digital and software/gaming publishing) must demonstrably exercise economic substance in Samoa: substantive management and control (board meetings in Samoa), adequate physical presence (registered office and local employees), and core income-generating activities performed in Samoa. Failure to do so results in denial of tax-exempt status, imposition of 27% tax on worldwide income from the mobile business, and deregistration penalties. For a hardcore MMORPG global operator, the royalty/software publishing income must be supported by a substance report showing actual decision-making, local IT staff, and active exploitation of the IP; a mere mailbox office is fatal.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Structuring a Samoan International Company as a shell to hold MMORPG IP and channel global in-app revenue without any Samoan economic substance, while falsely claiming tax exemption; or failing to file annual returns and declaring nil tax despite actual economic activities conducted in Samoa.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of the tax exemption certificate; retroactive taxation of all worldwide mobile-business income at 27%; penalty of up to 200% of the tax evaded; criminal fine up to WS$100,000 for the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who knowingly sign false declarations are personally liable for the unpaid tax and penalties; they may be subject to civil restitution orders, travel bans by the Supreme Court of Samoa, and imprisonment up to 5 years for tax evasion.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Mis-pricing intercompany royalties paid by the Samoan IC to a parent or affiliate for the MMORPG IP (e.g., excessive deductible royalty rates for no actual IP ownership), or shifting profits via a shell shareholder without arm's length consideration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: TP adjustment to arm's length, imposition of 27% tax on the adjusted profit, a TP penalty of 20%–50% of the adjusted amount, and late payment interest at 2% per month.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve or sign TP returns knowing they are not arm's length may be jointly and severally liable for adjusted taxes and penalties; flagrant cases attract criminal liability and disqualification from acting as a director of any Samoan IC.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Failure of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Registering an IC with no physical office, no local employees, no board meetings in Samoa, and no substantive functions, using it solely to route Apple/Google payouts and avoid home-country tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Removal from the International Companies Register; revocation of the tax exemption certificate; a non-compliance penalty of WS$100,000; and possible court-ordered dissolution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally fined WS$50,000 each, subjected to travel bans, and ordered to compensate the revenue loss by the Supreme Court. The corporate veil is pierced under the International Companies Act 2017 when the company is used for fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing the ultimate beneficial owner of the IC (e.g., using nominee directors and undisclosed trust structures) and failing to file with the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2019, despite low-risk gaming payment flow.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Corporate fine up to WS$250,000; disqualification of the registered agent; severe breaches lead to asset freezing by the FIU and prohibition from receiving Apple/Google payouts because payment intermediaries require compliance certifications.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual directors and ultimate beneficial owners face imprisonment up to 14 years for money laundering and failing to report beneficial ownership; personal asset seizure under the Proceeds of Crime Act; travel bans are routinely imposed.
